warnings: Warnings For oral use only. Gallstones, occlusion of the bile ducts, jaundice and any other unclear or persistent discomfort in the upper abdomen may be serious. Consult a doctor promptly if any of these symptoms occur. Do not use if you are allergic to Taraxacum, Carduus marianus or other plants from the daisy family (Compositae) you suffer from liver diseases Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 7 days, worsen or new symptoms occur.
